items.text: Russian missiles struck Kyiv early on 7 Nov, injuring at least five, closing a Dnipro bridge and damaging energy facilities in the Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions; Mayor [[p:Vitali Klitschko]] called the capital's power situation "extremely difficult". The death toll from the 2 Nov guided-bomb strike on Komyshuvakha rose to 55. The attacks come days before the US–Russia–Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi on 10 Nov.
items.thread: Russia–Ukraine front line and long-range strikes

items.text: US forces carried out a new "limited" strike on an Iranian air-defence system on Qeshm Island on 6 Nov; Iranian state media reported two explosions near Suza. [[p:Donald Trump]] called it "minor" and said Washington is talking to Tehran. Iran says it will not start nuclear talks until the blockade ends, sanctions are lifted and frozen assets released.
